title: A neural network that maintains and retrieves memories based on context
abstract: arXiv:2609.37791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Every day, people continuously infer situational context and adjust the way they understand and remember the world. Context, signaled by the prefrontal cortex, is known to modulate working memory and episodic memory, but the algorithmic understanding of this modulation remains limited. Here, we train a recurrent neural network (RNN), augmented with an episodic memory buffer, to infer context using Bayesian inference as it continuously makes predictions of upcoming scenes while watching naturalistic movies. When the inferred context modulates the RNN's recurrent connectivity (the basis of working memory) in a low-rank manner, the model's activity patterns best match neural responses in human participants who watched the same movies during fMRI. Context also modulates episodic memory retrieval, such that the model retrieves memories based on not only content similarity but also context similarity. This is implemented as a key-value system

translated_title: 一种基于情境维护和提取记忆的神经网络
translated_abstract: 每天，人们都会持续推断所处情境，并据此调整理解和记忆世界的方式。众所周知，由前额叶皮层传递的情境信号能够调节工作记忆和情景记忆，但对这种调节机制的算法层面理解仍然有限。在本研究中，我们训练了一个配备情景记忆缓冲区的循环神经网络（RNN），使其在观看自然电影并持续预测即将出现的场景时，运用贝叶斯推断来推断情境。当推断出的情境以低秩方式调节RNN的循环连接（即工作记忆的基础）时，模型的活动模式与在fMRI扫描中观看相同电影的人类被试的神经反应匹配度最高。情境还调节情景记忆的提取过程，使模型不仅依据内容相似性、还依据情境相似性来提取记忆。这一机制通过一个键值系统得以实现。
tldr: 该研究训练了一个结合情景记忆缓冲区的循环神经网络，通过贝叶斯推断情境并以低秩方式调节循环连接和记忆提取，其活动模式与人类fMRI神经反应最匹配，且能够同时基于内容相似性和情境相似性提取记忆。
en_tdlr: A recurrent neural network with an episodic memory buffer uses Bayesian context inference to low-rank modulate its recurrent connectivity and memory retrieval, best matching human fMRI neural responses while retrieving memories based on both content and context similarity.
